title: The sigma prompt engineer
description: Four prompting principles for people who are tired of vague answers.

scenes.narration: The model is not dumb. Your prompt is vague.
scenes.headline: Your prompt is vague

scenes.narration: Rule one. Give it context. Who it is, what the task is, and who the audience is.
scenes.headline: Rule 1: Context

scenes.narration: Rule two. Show it two good examples. Models copy patterns, not intentions.
scenes.headline: Rule 2: Examples

scenes.narration: Rule three. Demand sources. An answer without evidence is just confidence.
scenes.headline: Rule 3: Demand sources

scenes.narration: Rule four. Test the prompt on ten inputs, not one lucky demo.
scenes.headline: Rule 4: Test on ten inputs

scenes.narration: Do you test your prompts, or just trust the vibe?
scenes.headline: Test it or trust the vibe?
